name: Harborview Volunteer Services
what_you_do: Teens 16 and 17 help at the front desk and in the room where patients wait to go home. Adults 18 and up can also help in patient units and clinics.
who_can_apply: You must be 16 or older to help at the front desk. You must be 18 or older for patient units and clinics. If you are under 18, a parent must sign. You can only work Monday to Friday, 8 am to 5 pm.
duration: Four hours a week for six months in a row. No summer-only spots in the main program.
deadline_text: The 2026 volunteer application is closed. The page gives no reopening date; you can sign up to be told when it reopens.
how_to_apply: Apply online when it reopens and pick an in-person orientation date. Send proof of MMR, chickenpox and Tdap shots (and a flu shot October to March). Finish about three hours of online training, then pass a Washington State background check.
notes: Applications with missing shot records are denied, with no exemptions. It can take a few months to hear back. The volunteer office does not set up doctor shadowing. Questions: hmcvol@uw.edu.
